d728e56a643354f1553ada7cad107d61/f/d728e.text: Data is only an asset if it's accessible, actionable and used. Right now, most companies are data-rich and insight-poor. pour. Sitting on gold using teaspoons. Syntha changes that. Syntha is a retrieval augmented generation platform that turns all your content: documents, recordings, scanned forms, chat logs, into something your teams can talk to. Ask it a question and it doesn't guess. It retrieves relevant information, uses AI to synthesize a grounded answer and cites the source.

No glue code. No data science team. No waiting six months to see value. Syntha is a plug-and-play, enterprise-grade, ISO-certified, and works across cloud, hybrid, or on-prem. It's not just smarter search.

# Syntha, the RAG-as-a-Service platform

Syntha automatically delivers AI search and Generative Answers on top of your unstructured data, and provides knowledge in the form of trusted answers, in any language, and from any data.

Syntha allows you to customize your RAG pipeline and bring it directly to production.
With Syntha you can:

* Index any type of data in any language.
* Define your own retrieval strategy.
* Use any LLM to gain insights and knowledge from your data.
* Customize your prompt.
